theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Utilities (+0.07%) and Technology (+0.06%) led the market today, while Industrials (-0.29%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.26%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.09%, defensives +0.00%, and value/cyclicals -0.11% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.52%, Dow -0.51%, Nasdaq -0.32% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.35%. The VIX rose 3.36% to 15.70, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.05% to $4,450.30, crude oil was little changed at $84.32, and bitcoin slipped 0.36% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
